tests.name: Mock search provider returns typed and bounded results
tests.coverage: WebSearchProvider interface, MockSearchProvider fixture matching, limit enforcement

tests.name: Malformed provider responses and timeouts fail safely
tests.coverage: SearXNGSearchProvider timeout handling, non-JSON rejection, missing fields, rate limits (429)

tests.name: URL credentials and non-HTTPS destinations are rejected
tests.coverage: validateUrlSyntax, userinfo/credential rejection, http scheme rejection, custom non-443 port rejection

tests.name: Localhost, IPv4/IPv6 private networks, loopback, link-local, and metadata destinations rejected
Every redirect hop is revalidated
tests.coverage: Manual redirect loop inspection, cross-scheme rejection, private target rejection on redirect

tests.name: DNS results containing a prohibited IP are rejected
tests.coverage: resolveAndValidateHost, dual-homed / multi-record DNS resolution validation

tests.name: DNS-rebinding / TOCTOU limitations addressed by transport
tests.coverage: Pinned destination IP transport hook, custom lookup socket override

tests.name: Redirect loops and excessive hops are rejected
tests.coverage: Circular 302 detection, maxRedirects=3 hop limit enforcement

tests.name: Oversized bodies are stopped before excessive memory is consumed
tests.coverage: Streaming byte threshold enforcement (500 KB limit), abort stream on boundary breach

tests.name: Unsupported MIME types are rejected
tests.coverage: Content-Type whitelist enforcement, rejection of application/pdf, application/zip, audio/video

tests.name: HTML scripts, forms, and injected markup are excluded from extracted text
tests.coverage: extractHtmlMetadataAndText, removal of <script>, <style>, <nav>, <form>, <iframe>, HTML entity decoding

tests.name: Prompt-injection text is treated as untrusted content, not an instruction
tests.coverage: formatUntrustedResearchEnvelope, explicit Security Notice, isUntrustedContent: true metadata invariant

tests.name: All errors are bounded, structured, and free of secrets
tests.coverage: SearchProviderError, SafeFetchError, isSafeToExpose flag, credential stripping in error messages
